title: Store new service data in PostgreSQL
statement: New services keep their data in PostgreSQL through the shared pgx pool. Document stores such as MongoDB are not used for new services.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+package store
+
+import (
+	"context"
+
+	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/mongo"
+	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/mongo/options"
+)
+
+// Open connects the catalog to its database.
+func Open(ctx context.Context, uri string) (*mongo.Client, error) {
+	return mongo.Connect(options.Client().ApplyURI(uri))
+}

title: Log through the platform logger
statement: Services write runtime logs with log/slog through the logger that the platform package returns. The standard log package and the fmt.Print functions are not used for runtime logs.

title: Pin every action to a commit
statement: Workflows reference every action they use by its full 40-character commit SHA. A tag or a branch name is not used, because either can move to other code.
check_prompt: Look at each uses: line that the change adds or edits. An action of any owner counts, including actions/ and github/. A reusable workflow referenced by a local path is fine.

+        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
         with:
           push: true
           tags: ${{ env.IMAGE }}

title: Set a timeout on every outbound HTTP call
statement: Every HTTP client that calls another service sets an explicit Timeout. http.DefaultClient, http.Get and a zero-value http.Client are not used for calls to other services.

title: Keep money in integer minor units
statement: Amounts of money are stored and computed as int64 counts of the minor unit of their currency, such as cents. float32 and float64 are never used for an amount of money.

files.patch:
@@ -8,5 +8,6 @@ type Line struct {

 }

title: Write migrations forward only
statement: Each database migration only moves the schema forward. A migration has no Down section, and a mistake is fixed by a new migration.

title: Run containers as a non-root user
statement: Every container image the team builds ends with a USER instruction that names a non-root user, so the process never runs as root.

files.patch:
@@ -9,5 +9,4 @@ RUN go build -o /out/api ./cmd/api
 FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12
 COPY --from=build /out/api /api
-USER nonroot:nonroot
 EXPOSE 8080
 ENTRYPOINT ["/api"]

title: Read feature flags through the flags client
statement: Code reads a feature flag only through the client of the flags package, so a flag can change without a deploy. Reading a flag from an environment variable is not allowed.

title: Return problem details from the public API
statement: Every error that a public HTTP endpoint returns is an application/problem+json body as RFC 9457 defines it, written with the writeProblem helper. Plain text error bodies are not used.

title: Keep Terraform state in the shared remote backend
statement: Every Terraform root module stores its state in the shared S3 backend with state locking. Local state files are not used.

statement: New services keep their data in PostgreSQL through the shared pgx pool. Document stores such as MongoDB are not used for new services.

+package store
+
+import (
+	"context"
+
+	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
+)
+
+// Open connects the catalog to its database.
+func Open(ctx context.Context, url string) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) {
+	return pgxpool.New(ctx, url)
+}
